JSTACK / PRIVACY

Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 18, 2026

Tool inputs

JWTs, keys, secrets, JSON, and text entered into JStack tools are processed in your browser. This app does not send those inputs to a JStack application server, store them in local storage, or intentionally include them in analytics. Do not share production secrets with any website unless you have independently reviewed its code and deployment.

Hosting and technical requests

The site is designed for static hosting on Cloudflare Pages. The hosting provider may process technical request information such as IP address, user-agent, requested URL, and security events under its own terms and privacy practices. JStack does not operate a database or application backend.

Advertising, cookies, and consent

This site loads the Google AdSense script using publisher ID ca-pub-6808102016344239. Google and its advertising partners may use cookies, local storage, IP address, browser/device information, and ad interaction data to serve, measure, and personalize ads, subject to your consent choices and Google's policies. Ad personalization and cookie use can depend on your location and consent. Where legally required, the publisher must obtain valid consent before using storage or processing personal data for personalized advertising. This site does not currently include a consent-management platform; the publisher must configure an appropriate Google-certified CMP and consent integration before serving ads to users in regions where it is required. No analytics script is currently enabled.

External services

Google AdSense is loaded on the site and may make requests to Google advertising domains. The app does not load external fonts or make other third-party API calls during normal tool use. Links to other websites are opened only when a visitor chooses them; those sites have their own policies.

Contact and policy updates

Questions about this policy: shaikmukhuran@gmail.com or 720-752-1486. Update this policy if the site's hosting, data handling, advertising, or analytics practices change.

This page describes the current code configuration, not the hosting provider's practices or legal advice. The site operator should review it for their jurisdiction and actual deployment.
